verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server in two forms: a local install via `npx @paypal/mcp`, and a hosted remote server at mcp.paypal.com and mcp.sandbox.paypal.com. The remote server supports SSE and Streamable HTTP transports with token auth, offers a broad documented tool inventory, and has LLM quickstarts; a probe confirmed the MCP server docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that agents connect successfully in practice.
